Description: Infection from infectious mosquito bite leading to symptomatic disease, probability depends on infection-blocking immunity and clinical immunity
Infection from infectious mosquito bite leading to asymptomatic infection (due to clinical immunity reducing probability of symptoms)
Treatment of symptomatic cases with antimalarials
Progression from symptomatic to asymptomatic infection in absence of treatment or after treatment failure
Progression from patent asymptomatic infection to subpatent infection, rate depends on blood-stage immunity
Recovery from subpatent infection to susceptible state
Successful parasite clearance followed by prophylactic protection dependent on drug half-life
Treatment failure, entering asymptomatic infection state
Loss of prophylactic drug protection, return to susceptible state

Completion of extrinsic incubation period in mosquito, becoming infectious

Name: Drug efficacy (ACT)
Description: Percentage of treated individuals with no parasitological treatment failure for ACT

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia after non-artemisinin treatment
Description: Duration of gametocytaemia in treated infection for non-artemisinins

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia after ACT treatment
Description: Duration of gametocytaemia in treated infection for ACT

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia after ACT-PQ treatment
Description: Duration of gametocytaemia in treated infection for ACT with primaquine

Name: Duration of prophylaxis (short-acting drug)
Description: Duration of inhibitory antimalarial blood concentration for short-acting drug

Name: Duration of prophylaxis (long-acting drug)
Description: Duration of inhibitory antimalarial blood concentration for long-acting drug

Name: Reduction in infectiousness after non-artemisinin treatment
Description: Percentage reduction in average infectiousness following non-artemisinin treatment compared to state occupied prior to treatment

Name: Reduction in infectiousness after ACT/ACT-PQ treatment
Description: Percentage reduction in average infectiousness following ACT or ACT-PQ treatment compared to state occupied prior to treatment

Name: Pregnancy prevalence in population aged 15-45
Description: Estimated prevalence of pregnancy among the population aged 15-45, used for exclusion from MDA

Name: Correlation in participation between MDA rounds
Description: Correlation in individual participation between repeated rounds of MDA (0=random, 1=same individuals always participate or not)

Name: MDA coverage
Description: Percentage of individuals in the population treated during MDA (before exclusion of pregnant women)

Name: ACT coverage for symptomatic treatment
Description: Percentage of symptomatic cases receiving ACTs at baseline

Name: Non-ACT treatment efficacy
Description: Efficacy of non-ACT treatments at clearing parasites due to resistance

Name: ACT treatment efficacy
Description: Efficacy of ACTs at clearing parasites

Name: Relative infectivity of asymptomatic vs symptomatic
Description: Asymptomatic cases (A) are approximately 3-fold less likely to infect a biting mosquito than symptomatic (D)

Name: Relative infectivity of subpatent vs symptomatic
Description: Subpatent stage (U) is approximately 17-fold less likely to infect mosquitoes than symptomatic (D)
